description: The two detached buildings at the rear of 11 Burntwood Avenue have been used as two separate self-contained dwellings, known as 11C and 11D Burntwood Avenue, for a period of more than four years
decision_conditions: The submitted evidence is sufficient and to allow the Local Planning Authority to conclude that on the balance of probability, the properties at 11C and 11D Burntwood Avenue, Hornchurch have been in use as two residential dwellings (Use Class C3) continuously and without significant interruption for a period of at least four years.  As such, in accordance with Section 191(4) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended), it is the duty of the local planning authority to grant this application.
